title: Duplicate Billing Cycle Run for Postpaid Segment
content:
# Incident Report: Duplicate Billing Cycle Run for Postpaid Segment

**Document ID:** INC_C04_INC_2026_0163
**Category:** C04 — Billing & Invoices
**Department:** Billing
**Customer Scope:** all
**Last Updated:** 2026-07-08
**Version:** 1.0
**Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base

---
## Summary

A scheduling error in the billing batch job caused ~12,000 postpaid customers to be billed twice for the June cycle.

## Detection Method

Identified during routine NOC dashboard review, ahead of any customer-reported tickets.

## Timeline

Detected via automated reconciliation checks; batch job halted within 40 minutes; duplicate charges auto-reversed within 48 hours; affected customers notified via SMS.

| Time | Event | Observation | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| T+0 | Fault detected | Alarm/ticket volume triggers investigation | On-call engineer paged |
| T+10m | Initial triage | Affected scope estimated | Field/remote team engaged as needed |
| T+Xh | Interim mitigation | Partial service restored where possible | Status page updated |
| T+Yh | Full restoration | Service confirmed normal | Incident closed, RCA initiated if required |

## Customer Impact

Estimated customers affected and service categories impacted are recorded in the internal incident-management system (ref: INC-2026-0163). Customer-facing status was published under Network > Service Status for the outage duration.

## Initial Hypothesis

The initial working theory pointed to the most probable cause based on alarm signatures and affected-scope pattern; this was confirmed or revised during investigation.

## Investigation

The response team correlated alarm data, affected-site/customer patterns, and any recent change or third-party activity in the area to isolate the fault to a specific component or cause before applying a fix.

## Resolution

Service was restored per the timeline above. A follow-up Root Cause Analysis is tracked separately where applicable (see related_ids).

## Recovery Validation

Restoration was confirmed via monitoring returning to baseline and, where applicable, spot checks with affected customers before the incident was formally closed.

## Preventive Actions

Preventive/corrective actions arising from this incident are tracked in the linked RCA document, where one was raised.

## Lessons Learned

Clearer coordination with third parties or upstream partners in this region would help prevent a recurrence of this fault type.

## Related Documents

No directly linked documents are recorded for this item; refer to the relevant department for further guidance.
